models.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

encoding.tokenizer: matching frozen revision, whole-text tokenization with actual attention mask
encoding.all_native_document_query_normalization: Convert FP32 raw-h to FP64 before norm and L2; also for NATIVE reference
encoding.query_cache_key: model repo+revision, tokenizer, pooling, exact prefix+query text, dtype
encoding.invalid_native_or_reconstruction: Nonfinite or zero-norm rows are flagged; no epsilon zero-imputation. Repair only the affected computation, retain unrelated valid cells.

task.compressed_renderer_scope: Expression stress with state-dependent compression, length and token counts. Analyze separately; it cannot rescue an ATOMIC failure or identify encoder-internal causality.
task.gallery: 22 held-out relative targets in the same world, condition, view, renderer, origin; no anchors and no pooling across these dimensions
task.relevance: Binary AND of every explicit fact in query; all matching target documents are relevant
task.rank: FP64 cosine descending; absolute state ID ascending only for exact equality; no truth-based tie breaker
task.query_primary: 0.5*mean(48 same-entity two-fact queries)+0.5*mean(144 different-entity two-fact queries)

reconstruction.mu_U: sum_{V subset U} (-1)^(|U|-|V|) h(origin XOR mask(V))
reconstruction.phi_t: 1/8 - sum_{i in t} b_i/4 + sum_{{i,j} subset t} b_i*b_j/2
reconstruction.q: mu_empty + sum_i b_i*mu_i + sum_{ij in E} b_i*b_j*mu_ij + sum_{t in T} phi_t(b)*mu_t
reconstruction.target_blind: Each estimator reads only base, singleton, selected pair and selected triple anchors in its own origin, although native full cubes are cached for evaluation/reuse.
reconstruction.information_budget: 1+6+number_of_edges+number_of_triples, per origin; not the entire experiment's model forward count.

fixed_methods.design: native h at each target; diagnostic, not a target-blind method
uniform 64-state Walsh projection degree <= 2; diagnostic, not a query upper bound

calibration.G: minimum CAL mean world NMSE, average all 4 views x16 origins x22 targets
calibration.Q: maximum CAL mean world balanced two-fact nDCG@5
calibration.G_tie: sort by round(mean_NMSE,12), then candidate_id ascending
calibration.PART21_shortlist: Score all840 on NMSE; in each of10 partitions take8 by G_tie; evaluate all80 on Q. G winner is minimum over840; Q winner is best among80. This is the fixed shortlist procedure, not a global840 query oracle.
calibration.identical_winners: Reuse numerical computation; retain logical labels without counting independent evidence.
calibration.partial_family: Do not silently select from a truncated family. Keep fixed methods and other fully evaluated families running; report this family incomplete.

metrics.D: For fixed model,world,renderer: mean over6conditions*4views*64states of ||h_cvs - mean_{s'=0..63}(h_cvs')||^2. Same D for every method, condition and origin of this world.
metrics.world_condition_NMSE: mean over4views*16origins*22targets of ||q-h_target||^2, divided by common D; then conditions averaged equally.
metrics.D_invalid: D==0 or nonfinite: normalized geometry undefined; keep raw MSE and independently valid query results; no arbitrary floor or zero-imputation.
metrics.raw_MSE: squared L2 error summed across384 coordinates, then case mean; not divided by dimension
metrics.Q: balanced two-fact nDCG@5; higher better; raw proportions in CSV, pp for differences only
metrics.IDCG: sum_{rank=1..min(5,n_relevant)} 1/log2(rank+1), using the exact same22-target gallery
metrics.R22: secondary complete-state nearest-native identity retrieval among same22 targets; no comparison of absolute level with historical R384/R256

statistics.within_world: Equal condition/view/origin weights, with fixed half-half two-fact query strata

bootstrap.simultaneous: max absolute standardized centered bootstrap error
bootstrap.zero_sd: point interval for that series; exclude from division; critical=0 if all zero

statistics.family_coverage: Two separate simultaneous95% families; not a joint56-comparison95% claim
statistics.missing: Common complete worlds within each prespecified available family, report missing causes and actual n; unavailable entire series yields an availability-defined partial subfamily, never an effect-selected subset.
statistics.precision_planning: Q only: n2048, paired SD .15/.30 and critical about3 imply halfwidth .994/1.989pp; assumptions, not assurance or stopping rule. NMSE precision is separately reported.
statistics.conditional_scope: Conditional on frozen model checkpoints, word pools, templates, CAL sample and selected candidates; not repeated-training uncertainty.
